context.analysis:
## Overview
[The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and the US. It ensures strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance, and resilience for unstable rural connections.]

## Key Elements
* Patients (EU/US)
* Licensed Clinicians
* Compliance / Quality Assurance Auditors
* External Pharmacy / Partner Network
* Cross-Border Telehealth Platform (Software System)
* National e-Prescription Gateways (EU) & US Pharmacy Networks (HL7 FHIR)
* Third-Party Video Relay / TURN Network
* External Identity Providers (OAuth2/OIDC)
* Localized AI Model Registries

## Relationships
* Patients & Clinicians -> Platform: HTTPS / WSS (TLS 1.3) via global Anycast Load Balancing
* Platform -> National e-Prescription Gateways (EU) & US Pharmacy Networks: HTTPS / REST with mTLS and signed JWTs (R-02, R-08)
* Platform -> Third-Party Video Relay / TURN Network: WebRTC / SRTP over DTLS with ephemeral tokens (R-06)
* Platform -> External Identity Providers: OAuth2 / OIDC over HTTPS
* Auditors -> Platform: IAM-restricted Read-Only APIs (R-04, R-07)

## Technology Stack
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Primary cloud provider hosting regions `europe-west3` and `us-central1`
* GCP VPC Service Controls: Hard-enforces regional data residency and trust boundaries (R-05)
* TLS 1.3 & mTLS: Secures all data in transit and inter-service communications
* SRTP over DTLS: Encrypts media streams for video consultations (R-06)
* OAuth2 / OIDC & PBAC: Manages clinician MFA and purpose-based access control (R-04)
* Cosign / Sigstore: Cryptographically signs AI model registry artifacts for EU MDR compliance (R-07)
* HL7 FHIR: Standard for US pharmacy interoperability (R-08)

## Rationale
[This architecture enforces strict regional isolation and compliance mandates (GDPR, HIPAA, EU MDR) while maintaining high availability for low-bandwidth rural users. Decentralized regional deployments protect patient privacy without compromising cross-border functionality.]

containers.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency while ensuring high availability for rural users and compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR.

## Key Elements
* Patients (EU and US) and Licensed Clinicians
* GKE Clusters in `europe-west3` (EU) and `us-central1` (US)
* API Gateway & BFF (Go / Envoy)
* Video Consultation Container (WebRTC SFU / MediaSoup)
* E-Prescription Integration Container (Node.js / Express)
* AI Symptom Checker Container (Python / FastAPI)
* Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL) and Cloud Storage (WORM enabled)
* External Identity Providers (OAuth2/OIDC), National e-Prescription Gateways, and US Pharmacy Networks (HL7 FHIR)

## Relationships
* Patients and Clinicians connect via HTTPS/WebSocket over TLS 1.3 to the regional API Gateway (Envoy).
* API Gateway routes internal traffic using mTLS over gRPC/REST to core services, enforcing OAuth2/OIDC token validation and R-04 purpose-based consent.
* WebRTC media streams utilize DTLS-SRTP terminating at the MediaSoup SFU Container.
* E-Prescription Container connects to US Pharmacy Networks via HL7 FHIR and national gateways in the EU.
* AI Symptom Checker logs inputs, outputs, and signed model versions to regional Cloud Storage.

## Technology Stack
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`), GKE, VPC Service Controls, Cloud KMS for CMEK.
* **API & Gateway:** Go, Envoy Proxy, gRPC, REST, mTLS.
* **Video & Streaming:** WebRTC, MediaSoup SFU (supporting adaptive bitrate down to 150 kbit/s with audio-only fallback).
* **Application Services:** Node.js / Express (E-Prescriptions), Python / FastAPI (AI Symptom Checker).
* **Data & Storage:** Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), Cloud Storage with WORM policies.
* **Operations & Security:** ArgoCD (GitOps), Argo Rollouts, Cosign (container signing), Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos.

## Rationale
This architecture uses isolated regional GKE deployments governed by VPC Service Controls and GitOps to strictly enforce regional data residency and compliance (GDPR/HIPAA/MDR). It incorporates adaptive WebRTC media routing, cryptographic AI model traceability, and purpose-based consent management to meet both rural accessibility needs and rigorous healthcare regulations.

API Gateway & BFF.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency, GDPR/HIPAA compliance, and low-bandwidth resilience for rural users.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU and US)
- Licensed Clinicians
- API Gateway & BFF (Go, Envoy Proxy)
- Geo-Enforcement & Routing Proxy (Envoy Proxy)
- Consent & Auth Middleware (Go)
- BFF Aggregator & Transformer (Go)
- Telemetry & Resilience Interceptor (Go)
- Downstream Containers: Video Consultation Container (MediaSoup), E-Prescription Integration Container (Node.js), AI Symptom Checker Container (Python)
- External Identity Providers (OAuth2/OIDC)
- Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL)
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)

## Relationships
- Patients & Clinicians -> API Gateway & BFF: Accesses telehealth services [HTTPS / WebSocket over TLS 1.3]
- API Gateway & BFF -> External Identity Providers (OAuth2/OIDC): Validates user authentication tokens [OAuth2 / OIDC]
- API Gateway & BFF -> Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL): Caches user consent policies [mTLS / TCP]
- BFF Aggregator & Transformer -> AI Symptom Checker Container: Routes symptom check requests [gRPC over mTLS with W3C Trace Context]
- API Gateway & BFF -> E-Prescription Integration Container: Routes prescription data [mTLS over gRPC/REST]
- API Gateway & BFF -> Video Consultation Container: Routes session management [mTLS over gRPC/REST]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud utilizing `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for strict data residency.
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Container orchestration with Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA) and Argo Rollouts for progressive delivery.
- Envoy Proxy: Edge termination, TLS 1.3, regional geo-routing, rate limiting, and connection resilience.
- Go (Golang): Implementation language for Consent & Auth Middleware, BFF Aggregator, and Telemetry Interceptor.
- PASETO: Cryptographically signed internal headers for zero-trust context propagation.
- W3C Trace Context: Distributed tracing standard for monitoring rural network latencies.

## Rationale
Regional API Gateway deployments physically isolate EU and US health data to satisfy strict GDPR and HIPAA mandates. Built-in payload compression, circuit breaking, and telemetry ensure high availability and graceful degradation for rural patients on unstable connections.

Video Consultation Container.analysis:
## Overview
Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. The system enforces strict regional data residency while ensuring high availability for users with unstable internet connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU/US) and Licensed Clinicians
- API Gateway & BFF (Go, Envoy Proxy)
- Video Consultation Container (WebRTC SFU, MediaSoup)
- E-Prescription Integration Container (Node.js, Express)
- AI Symptom Checker Container (Python, FastAPI)
- Cloud SQL PostgreSQL and Google Cloud Storage
- Third-Party Video Relay / TURN Network
- National e-Prescription Gateways (EU) & US Pharmacy Networks (HL7 FHIR)

## Relationships
- Patients & Clinicians -> Video Consultation Container: Streams video via WebRTC [DTLS-SRTP]
- API Gateway & BFF -> Signaling Server: Authenticates requests [WSS / mTLS over gRPC/REST]
- Signaling Server -> SFU Media Router: Manages worker processes [Local IPC]
- SFU Media Router <-> Third-Party TURN Network: Relays media for NAT traversal [ICE/TURN over UDP/TCP]
- E-Prescription Integration Container -> EU Gateways / US Pharmacy Networks: Transmits prescriptions [HL7 FHIR / National Standards]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Deployed in `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for regional data residency compliance.
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Manages container orchestration with isolated node pools and NetworkPolicies.
- MediaSoup (C++): Powers the SFU media router for encrypted media handling (DTLS-SRTP).
- Node.js & WebSockets: Implements the Signaling Server and Adaptive Bitrate Controller.
- Prometheus & GKE HPA: Handles custom observability and autoscaling based on active rooms and network throughput.

## Rationale
This architecture guarantees strict regulatory compliance by enforcing data residency per region on GCP. Furthermore, the MediaSoup SFU with adaptive bitrate down to 150 kbit/s ensures reliable video consultations for rural patients with unstable connections.

E-Prescription Integration Container.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It ensures strict data residency, regulatory compliance, and high availability across unstable internet connections.

## Key Elements
* **Patients & Licensed Clinicians**: Primary end-users of the telehealth platform.
* **API Gateway & Gateway-Backend (BFF)**: Built with Go and Envoy Proxy.
* **E-Prescription Integration Container**: Built with Node.js and Express, containing Prescription Router, National Gateway Adapter, Prescription State & Event Manager, and Prescription Outbox & Retry Processor.
* **AI Symptom Checker Container**: Built with Python and FastAPI.
* **Data & Messaging Storage**: Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), Google Cloud Storage (WORM enabled), Cloud Pub/Sub, and regional Memorystore (Redis).
* **External Systems**: National e-Prescription Gateways (EU) and US Pharmacy Networks (HL7 FHIR).

## Relationships
* **API Gateway & BFF -> E-Prescription Integration Container**: Routes e-prescription requests via mTLS over gRPC/REST.
* **National Gateway Adapter -> National e-Prescription Gateways & US Pharmacy Networks**: Dispatches prescriptions using HL7 FHIR and REST over mTLS.
* **Prescription State & Event Manager -> Cloud SQL**: Persists audit logs and states using the PostgreSQL Protocol.
* **Prescription State & Event Manager -> Cloud Pub/Sub**: Publishes lifecycle events for the BFF via gRPC over TLS.

## Technology Stack
* **Go & Envoy Proxy**: Powers the API Gateway and BFF for performant routing.
* **Node.js & Express**: Powers the E-Prescription Integration Container for asynchronous event handling.
* **Python & FastAPI**: Used for the AI Symptom Checker Container to handle machine learning workflows.
* **PostgreSQL & Redis (BullMQ)**: Manages relational data and transactional outbox queues.
* **GCP (europe-west3, us-central1)**: Provides regional cloud infrastructure, GKE Confidential Computing, Cloud HSM, and Cloud KMS to enforce data residency.

## Rationale
This architecture ensures strict GDPR and HIPAA compliance by isolating regional data storage and compute workloads within specific GCP regions. Furthermore, the inclusion of transactional outbox patterns, circuit breakers, and regional encryption guarantees high availability and data sovereignty for cross-border telemedicine.

Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL).analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. It ensures strict data residency, regulatory compliance, and high availability even over unstable connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU/US) & Licensed Clinicians
- API Gateway & BFF (Go, Envoy Proxy)
- Video Consultation Container (WebRTC SFU, MediaSoup)
- E-Prescription Integration Container (Node.js, Express)
- AI Symptom Checker Container (Python, FastAPI)
- Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL 15+) with PgBouncer
- Google Cloud Storage (WORM enabled)

## Relationships
- `API Gateway & BFF` -> `Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL)`: Relational queries for user profiles and consent management [PostgreSQL Protocol over TLS 1.3]
- `E-Prescription Integration Container` -> `Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL)`: Persists structured e-prescription data [PostgreSQL Protocol over TLS 1.3]
- `AI Symptom Checker Container` -> `Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL)`: Persists symptom logs and model version metadata [PostgreSQL Protocol over TLS 1.3]

## Technology Stack
- **Google Cloud Platform (GCP):** Deployed in `europe-west3` and `us-central1` to enforce strict data residency.
- **Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL 15+):** Relational storage with PgBouncer connection pooling and multi-zone HA failover.
- **Cloud KMS:** Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) with 90-day rotation for regional compliance.
- **Google Cloud Storage:** WORM-enabled buckets for immutable audit logs and AI model version traceability.
- **Terraform & ArgoCD:** GitOps-driven deployment and automated zero-downtime schema migrations.

## Rationale
Physical regional database segregation in GCP satisfies GDPR and HIPAA mandates while avoiding complex logical partitioning. Combining IAM authentication, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, and TLS 1.3 guarantees data privacy, strict isolation of AI and prescription data, and full auditability.

Cloud Storage (WORM enabled).analysis:
## Overview
[The system is a cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. Its core purpose is delivering secure, compliant telemedicine services while enforcing strict regional data residency and auditability.]

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU/US), Licensed Clinicians, Compliance / Quality Assurance Auditors
- API Gateway & BFF (Go, Envoy Proxy)
- Video Consultation Container (WebRTC SFU, MediaSoup)
- E-Prescription Integration Container (Node.js, Express)
- AI Symptom Checker Container (Python, FastAPI)
- Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL)
- Cloud Storage (WORM enabled) (Google Cloud Storage)
- External Pharmacy Networks, National e-Prescription Gateways (EU), US Pharmacy Networks (HL7 FHIR)

## Relationships
- AI Symptom Checker Container -> Cloud Storage (WORM enabled): Asynchronous log ingestion and model retrieval [Cloud Storage APIs, HTTPS (REST)]
- API Gateway & BFF -> Containers: Request routing and authorization [HTTPS, gRPC]
- Video Consultation Container -> Third-Party Video Relay: Real-time media streaming [WebRTC, TURN]
- E-Prescription Integration Container -> National Gateways/Pharmacies: E-prescription delivery [HL7 FHIR, REST]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider utilizing regions `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for strict data residency.
- Go & Python (FastAPI): High-performance languages for API gateways and AI workloads.
- Google Cloud Storage (GCS): Object storage configured with Object Retention Lock (WORM) and CMEK for immutable compliance logging.
- Terraform: Infrastructure as Code for automated, drift-free deployment of security and storage policies.

## Rationale
[This architecture satisfies strict GDPR and HIPAA mandates by isolating regional data and securing AI diagnostic logs in immutable WORM storage. It maintains high availability and low latency for patients through asynchronous logging and regional multi-zone redundancy.]
